Name: Pandaborn - Look prototype (dev only)
Description: Development-only prototype (swap variant): re-themes every vanilla Folktails building model for the Inkpaws faction of Pandaborn - Factions. In an Inkpaws game a small script copies this mod's bundle materials into the vanilla materials of the same name and restores them when the game ends; Folktails and Iron Teeth games are untouched. Never shipped. Art and code are AI-generated.
